newsitem.title: FRANCE: France had record 15.99 bln Ffr Apr trade surplus.
newsitem.headline: France had record 15.99 bln Ffr Apr trade surplus.

text.p: France had a record seasonally adjusted trade surplus in April of 15.985 billion francs compared with a revised surplus in March of 9.712 billion, provisional customs office data showed on Friday.
A customs office spokesman said April's monthly figure was an "absolute record". For March, the office had originally reported an adjusted surplus of 9.817 billion francs.
Imports slipped to 120.39 billion francs in April from 121.05 billion while exports rose to 136.37 from 130.76.
